run_dreambooth_lora_training: run DreamBooth LoRA training on Z-Image model with instance images and validation prompts
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for DreamBooth LoRA training including dataset paths, learning rates, and LoRA config
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads instance and class images with aspect-ratio bucketing and custom prompts
validate_trained_model: validate a trained LoRA model by generating images with a fixed prompt and logging to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card: generate a model card README with gallery images, trigger words, and usage instructions for a trained LoRA
